main_panel_name_note: v1 in the panel name is the old request-design version, not the data release
additional_panel_use: evaluation only; never type discovery, feature fitting, hyperparameter selection or calibrator fitting

evaluation_units.primary: event mean within image, then image mean within building, then buildings equally weighted
additional: existing direct room-group weighting only where available
evaluation_units.interval: 2000 building bootstrap replicates, fixed seed 20261019; multiple events are not independent observations

common_events: Attach every method to the same event_id. Preserve full method coverage and intersection coverage. Primary methods compared by paired building Brier changes on identical events, including unknown-label baseline fallback.
strata: same target point count diagnostic only

interchangeability.main_tolerance: both complete; absolute B8L2 change<=2; floor Jaccard difference<=0.05; equal node count; bound cyclic endpoint maximum<=3 degrees
interchangeability.strict: both complete; absolute B8<=1; floor difference<=0.02; equal nodes; endpoint maximum<=2 degrees
interchangeability.loose: both complete; absolute B8<=5; floor difference<=0.10; equal nodes; endpoint maximum<=5 degrees
interchangeability.not_independent_criteria: Joint threshold is only a shared summary. Signed and absolute Q changes, floor, nodes, shared edge relationships, upper/lower changes and failures are separately reported.
interchangeability.claim_limit: Non-significant differences do not establish equivalence. Same category does not guarantee interchangeable members or correct output. No post hoc threshold chosen to create a positive class result.

last_seat_selection.scope: Choose the last member of an already fixed k-1 background, between the two registered candidates. Not a search for the globally best full team.
last_seat_selection.random: expected outcome of equal probability a/b
last_seat_selection.Q: choose larger historical building-out beta; exact ties use random expectation
last_seat_selection.QD: choose larger supported target-difficulty historical theta; unknown excluded from that policy's support
last_seat_selection.QT: if absolute historical beta difference>3 choose larger beta; otherwise choose smaller source-adjusted historical log-time; missing time policy remains unknown
last_seat_selection.QTD: same 3 point candidate band using supported target-difficulty theta; then smaller source-adjusted historical log-time
last_seat_selection.discovered_class: choose higher training-class mean historical beta, computed only from that training set; within-class ties use random expectation
last_seat_selection.cost: full team source time only when all members known. Incremental a/b entrant time can be compared when both entrant times known because fixed background cancels; this does not fill missing full team time. Target-specific time kept separate.
last_seat_selection.failures: completion probability retains all supported choices; conditional Q on two scored endpoints is separate; optional zero-utility failure sensitivity applies to team decisions only, never personal Q or eligibility

class_diagnostics: number and exact members of all/singleton/dyad classes
within-class pair support and worst supported pair; no connected-component equivalence assumption
coassignment stability across folds, invariant to class numbering
unknown and coverage loss by worker/image/building
training explanation fit vs cross-worker and cross-building perturbation fidelity separately
case_selection: After summary freeze, choose at most 8 cases using within-class stable, within-class large change/failure, between-class stable, between-class change with improvement, stable-low-Q categories. Preserve eligible counts and deterministic severity/tie ordering; cases never feed model selection.
out_of_scope: claim of independent full Dot replay
